name: literal-read-batch1
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import glob,hashlib,json,os
base="/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus"
ids=[349943,346153,347791,349042,350668,338937,340221,381331,332023,326946]
want=set(ids); found={}
dec=json.JSONDecoder()
for f in sorted(glob.glob(base+"/mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl")):
    raw=open(f,"rb").read(); fsha=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    for i,line in enumerate(raw.split(b"\n"),1):
        if not line.strip(): continue
        try: obj=json.loads(line.decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception: continue
        mid=obj.get("mathdb_id")
        if mid in want and mid not in found:
            s=line.decode("utf-8")
            k=s.find('"statement"'); c=s.find(':',k)
            tok,end=dec.raw_decode(s[c+1:].lstrip())
            tokb=json.dumps(tok,ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
            found[mid]={"path":f,"chunk_sha":fsha,"line":i,
                "raw_len":len(line),"raw_sha":hashlib.sha256(line).hexdigest(),
                "nl":raw.endswith(b"\n"),
                "tok_sha":hashlib.sha256(tokb).hexdigest(),
                "stmt_sha":hashlib.sha256(tok.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
                "stmt":tok,"title":obj.get("title"),
                "status":obj.get("status"),"source_url":obj.get("source_url"),
                "source_name":obj.get("source_name"),
                "first_stated_year":obj.get("first_stated_year"),
                "documented_by_source_url":obj.get("documented_by_source_url"),
                "documented_by_year":obj.get("documented_by_year"),
                "solution_count":obj.get("solution_count"),"solutions":obj.get("solutions"),
                "references":obj.get("references"),"tags":obj.get("tags"),
                "statement_completeness":obj.get("statement_completeness")}
for mid in ids:
    v=found[mid]
    print("### ID",mid,"|",v["title"])
    print("chunk_path",v["path"])
    print("chunk_sha",v["chunk_sha"],"line",v["line"],"raw_len",v["raw_len"],"raw_sha",v["raw_sha"],"trailing_newline",v["nl"])
    print("stmt_token_sha",v["tok_sha"],"stmt_text_sha",v["stmt_sha"])
    print("status",v["status"],"| source_url",v["source_url"],"| source_name",v["source_name"])
    print("first_stated_year",v["first_stated_year"],"| documented_by",v["documented_by_source_url"],v["documented_by_year"])
    print("solution_count",v["solution_count"],"| solutions",json.dumps(v["solutions"],ensure_ascii=False))
    print("tags",json.dumps(v["tags"],ensure_ascii=False),"| completeness",v["statement_completeness"])
    print("STATEMENT:")
    print(v["stmt"])
    print()
